In the present case, it is not disputed that the claimants had travelled in the Bajaj tempo as inmates.
Hence, the claimants are not categorized as third parties.
Therefore, where the policy is Act Policy/Liability only policy, the Insurance Company is liable to indemnify only for third parties and others compulsorily covered as per Section 147 of MV Act.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Since, in the present case,
it is proved that the insurance policy is Act Policy/Liability only Policy and the claimants being inmates of Bajaj tempo are not third party.
Therefore, the Insurance Company is not liable to indemnify the owner of Bajaj tempo.
Further there is no evidence that the owner has paid extra/additional premium to cover the risk of inmates also.
